items.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在主场意大利大奖赛中从发车位第19位（实际为第12位）一路夺冠，成为全场焦点。The 比赛 回顾了本站其他表现出色或令人失望的车手。

items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli stole the show by winning his home Italian Grand Prix from 19th on the grid, in effect 12th. The Race looks back at the other drivers who shone or struggled in the race.
detailZh: 基米·安东内利从发车区第19位发车并赢得他的主场一级方程式（F1）比赛，抢尽了风头，那么在意大利大奖赛中还有谁表现出色呢？
比赛早期的一次严重撞车、车手们在场上不断攻防进退，以及后半段对胜利的追逐，使得这场蒙扎比赛充满了活力——但有些人的离开会远比其他人更开心。
以下是我们挑选的意大利比赛日的赢家和输家。
是的，也许必须提到几个前提条件——本质上是（在重启后的发车位置）从第12位而非第19位取胜；以及虚拟安全车期间的进站——这些因素让这场胜利无法跻身一级方程式历史上最伟大的从头领先到尾的胜利之列。
但不要因此贬低安东内利的表现。他看起来气势逼人、敏锐果断——在重新发车后仅两圈就强行切入领先集团的中心，此后他就像一个必然的赢家。
毫无疑问，现在没有任何力量能阻止这场冠军冲击了。——杰克·科曾斯
冷静下来理性地看，法拉利无论派出刘易斯·汉密尔顿还是夏尔·勒克莱尔，这个周末都不太可能有太大作为——因为梅赛德斯的引擎和能量输出效率才是主导一切的力量。
但如今的法拉利不会走“平庸”路线——它走的是“天都要塌了”的路线，而且在蒙扎的主场，天塌了一次又一次，因为安东内利抢走了主场车迷们的宠爱。
无论车队内部对第一次减速弯中勒克莱尔与汉密尔顿接触事件如何判定，这一幕在公开场合都极为尴尬，再加上勒克莱尔随后在帕拉波利卡弯（Parabolica）出弯时的惨状，更是雪上加霜。随后法拉利在虚拟安全车时机上运气不佳，这使汉密尔顿无法像前方其他使用中性胎的车手那样获得同样的“免费进站”战略选择。不过，他之所以没能和那些车手在一起，很可能正是因为第一次减速弯的那次冲突。
勒克莱尔肯定心碎不已。汉密尔顿则难以掩饰自己的沮丧——他公开指责车队“没有规则”，同时还对领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔（Fred Vasseur）施加着越来越大的压力。
最终，这不仅仅是一个糟糕的结果，而且是以一种格外痛苦且代价高昂的方式得出的这个结果。——瓦连京·霍罗恩日（Valentin Khorounzhiy）
维斯塔潘真的曾经有机会争夺冠军吗？
也许不是。进站后与奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里缠斗所损失的时间，肯定让这种希望彻底破灭了。
但不管比赛中忽上忽下的局面起了多大作用，能再次看到维斯塔潘在领先集团的激烈争夺中大显身手，这不是很棒吗？
当然，他的英勇表现为他赢得了远比《The 比赛》（包括本文作者）在周五晚上所预期的要好得多的成绩。——JC
对拉塞尔来说这绝不是一场糟糕的比赛，但比赛中间的虚拟安全车给了安东内利（以及维斯塔潘）一次免费进站的机会，这实际上是导致他失利的关键。
“我当时用的是硬胎，基米用的是中性胎，所以如果我们中有人要进站的话，那也会是基米，我想这就是为什么我对虚拟安全车出现的时机感到有点恼火，因为对于用中性胎的那些车手来说，很难和用硬胎的任何人竞争，”他说。
拉塞尔在比赛尾声于1号弯减速弯成功防守住了安东内利的进攻，安东内利在那里出现失误，冲进砂石区，差点毁掉整场比赛，但最终没能完成超越。
拉塞尔看到了一些积极因素，他指出与之前相比，蒙扎的节奏有所提升，而且获胜差距只有微小的3.8秒。
“我当然很想今天夺冠，但我的表现比我之前要好得多，”他说。
他在失利后依然风度翩翩，没有贬低安东内利逆转夺胜的表现，对领奖台上的嘘声也不太在意——但现实如今已经很残酷：安东内利领先66分，而且势头强劲。——萨马特·卡纳尔（Samarth Kanal）
这就是《The 比赛》在制定这份榜单时讨论的问题。但诺里斯之所以入选，是因为他从糟糕的排位赛中实现了不错的复苏，克服了刹车问题，并最终在比赛尾声一场混乱的迈凯伦内斗中获胜（而且保持了冷静）拿下第四名。
这个成绩——是在他近来较为疲软的一个周末中拼回来的，本应该被队友击败——进一步证明卫冕冠军目前的水准有多高。——JC
兰斯·斯特罗尔引发虚拟安全车（VSC）的退赛对比赛产生了巨大影响——但这却是那两辆实力明显不济的阿斯顿·马丁AMR26在这里唯一能够施加影响力的方式。
由于一练电池问题（用阿隆索的话说，问题已“被了解”但“没有完全解决”）导致动力单元更换，他从维修区发车。这位西班牙车手在重启后跑得非常勇猛，并表示能够真的与凯迪拉克较量让他感到惊喜，“因为我们原以为自己只能孤军奋战”。
但他在莱斯莫二号弯明显冲出了赛道，造成了一些赛车损伤，阿隆索很快就把车停了回来——随后斯特罗尔的AMR26也因液压问题退赛。
无论如何，这场比赛本来也拿不出什么好成绩。事后肯定会有调查总结，但目前可以明确的是，即使在本田的引擎升级之后，阿斯顿·马丁在动力占优的赛道上依然毫无竞争力。——VK
看看发车顺位，就车队总冠军相对阿尔派的优势（经国际上诉法庭裁定而扩大）而言，小红牛本来可能已经做好了挨打的准备。当两辆阿尔派在重启后分别排在第二和第四位发车时，这种担心更是加倍。（而且角田裕毅还差点走错发车格。）
加斯利本来很可能在领先集团中被往后挤，而科拉平托的失控也给小红牛帮了忙，但即便如此，小红牛把掉分总数限制在仅仅三分，依然是这轮比赛的赢家。
这有赖于越来越可靠的阿尔维德·林德布拉德又度过了一个出色的周末——他建立了足够的缓冲，顶住了科拉平托在比赛后段对第八名的冲击；而角田裕毅在找到正确的发车位后，在重新发车时把握机会从内侧攻入一号弯，从第14位升至第11位，随后又高效地处理掉了比他慢的奥利·比尔曼的哈斯赛车。
而且，如今他已经逃过了因发车位险些违规而可能受的处罚，谁又能不认可他这带回的一分呢？——JC
劳森因发动机处罚不得不从维修区通道发车，但这本身并不能成为他缺乏名次提升的借口。（参考安东内利。）
红牛赛车实际上曾一度升至第11位，但在与奥迪车手尼科·霍肯伯格的一次碰撞中损失了部分前翼——为此劳森被出示了黑白驾驶规范警示旗。
由此导致的提前进站让他损失了不少位置，随后比赛中的虚拟安全车（VSC）基本上浇灭了劳森翻盘的希望，因为小红牛和阿尔派最终都进入了前十名。
在赛车尾部装上一台新引擎后，劳森表示他希望以“相当靠前的积分名次”完赛，而且他看到维斯塔潘挡住了迈凯伦和法拉利的进攻，那么他本有可能以大约第七名的成绩完赛——这正是杆位发车的加斯利最终取得的名次。
所以，这无疑又是一个令人沮丧的周末。 — SK
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli stole the show by winning his home Formula 1 race from 19th on the grid, but who else shone in the Italian Grand Prix?
A big early crash, back-and-forths up and down the field, and the late hunt for victory made this a lively Monza race - but some will be leaving far happier than others.
Here's our pick of winners and losers from race day in Italy.

Yes, maybe the couple of caveats that have to be mentioned - essentially taking victory from 12th (on the restart grid) not 19th; the virtual safety car pitstop - keep this victory out of the pantheon of greatest front-to-back wins in F1 history.
But take nothing away from Antonelli. He looked imperious, incisive - and like an inevitable winner once he'd forced his way right into the heart of the leading pack just two laps after the restart.
Surely there's no stopping this title charge now. - Jack Cozens

In the cold light of day, it feels exceptionally unlikely that Ferrari, with either Lewis Hamilton or Charles Leclerc, was going to get too much out of this weekend - as Mercedes's engine and deployment efficiency was the dominant force.
But the Ferrari of today doesn't do 'mediocre' - it does 'sky is falling down', and in the home confines of Monza it fell down repeatedly as Antonelli stole the adoration of the home crowd instead.

Whatever the inside-team ruling on the Leclerc/Hamilton encounter at the first chicane, it was very publicly embarrassing in conjunction with Leclerc's subsequent devastating Parabolica exit. Then Ferrari got unlucky with the virtual safety car timing, which didn't offer Hamilton the same strategic 'free stop' option as his fellow medium runners ahead. Though the reason he wasn't with them may well have been that very first chicane run-in.

Leclerc must surely be devastated. Hamilton is struggling to hide his frustration - and has publicly accused his team of having "no rules", while also putting increasing pressure on team principal Fred Vasseur.
In the end, it's not just a bad result. It's also a particularly painful and costly way of getting there. - Valentin Khorounzhiy
Was Verstappen ever a genuine contender for victory?
Maybe not. Any hope of that certainly faded with the time lost in battle with Oscar Piastri after pitting.
But regardless of how big a part the yo-yo nature of the racing played, how good was it to see Verstappen in the hustle and bustle of the lead fight once again?
Certainly, his heorics were put to good use in securing a far better result than The Race (and this writer specifically) saw coming on Friday evening. - JC
By no means was this a poor race for Russell, but he was essentially undone by the mid-race virtual safety car that gave Antonelli (and Verstappen) a free pitstop.

"I was on the hard tyre and Kimi was on the medium tyre, so if either of us were to pit, it was going to be Kimi and that's I guess why I was just a little bit annoyed with the timing of that VSC because it would have been tough for those guys on the medium to have competed with anybody on the hard tyre," he said.
Russell did well in defending against Antonelli late on at the opening chicane, where Antonelli miscued and almost threw it all away with a trip into the gravel, but there was no defence in the end.
Russell took some positives, citing an uptick in pace at Monza compared to before, and the slight 3.8-second margin of victory.
"I would have loved to have won today, but the performance is far better than I've had," he said.

He was also gracious in defeat, taking nothing away from Antonelli's recovery to victory, and paying little attention to the podium boos - but the reality is now stark: Antonelli is 66 points ahead and going strong. - Samarth Kanal

That's the debate The Race had when putting this list together. But Norris gets the nod by dint of this being a decent recovery from a poor qualifying, dealing with a brake issue, and ultimately prevailing (and keeping his cool) in a scrappy McLaren battle for fourth late on.

That result - salvaged on one of his weaker weekends of late, where he should really have been defeated by his team-mate - is more evidence of the level the defending champion is operating at right now. - JC
Lance Stroll's VSC-triggering exit has a massive impact on the race - but that was the only way the badly outmatched AMR26s were ever going to influence things here.

Starting from the pitlane in the aftermath of power unit changes necessitated by the battery issue in Q1 - "understood" but "not totally solved", in Fernando Alonso's words - the Spaniard had a feisty run after the restart, and claims he was pleasantly surprised to be actually fighting the Cadillacs "because we thought we were on our own".
But an apparent off at Lesmo 2 created some car damage, and Alonso soon parked it up - before Stroll's AMR26 gave out with a hydraulics issue.

In any case, there was going to be no great result on offer. An inquest will surely follow, but for now it's clear Aston Martin is not competitive at all on power tracks even after Honda's engine upgrade. - VK

Looking at the starting grid, Racing Bulls might've been braced for a battering as far as its (International Court of Appeal-enhanced) constructors' championship advantage over Alpine was concerned. Doubly so when the Alpines lined up second and fourth for the restart. (And when Yuki Tsunoda almost headed for the wrong grid slot.)

Gasly was always likely to regress through the leading pack, and Colapinto's off played into its hands too, but even so Racing Bulls comes out of this a winner for limiting its points-dropped total to just three.

That relied on the increasingly dependable Arvid Lindblad stringing together another excellent weekend - building up enough of a buffer to resist Colapinto's late charge for eighth - and Tsunoda, once he'd found the right grid slot, launching his car opportunistically up the inside into Turn 1 to move from 14th to 11th at the restart and then dealing with Ollie Bearman's slower Haas efficiently.
And, now he's escaped any penalty for that grid-position near-miss, who could begrudge him that comeback point? - JC
Lawson had to start from the pitlane with engine penalties but that alone wasn't an excuse for a lack of progression. (See Antonelli.)
The Red Bull was actually up to 11th before losing part of his front wing in a skirmish with Audi's Nico Hulkenberg - for which Lawson was shown a black-and-white driving standards flag.
The resulting early pitstop set him back, and then the mid-race VSC pretty much killed off Lawson's hopes of a comeback as the Racing Bulls and Alpine finished in the top 10.

With a new engine in the back of his car, Lawson said he hoped to finish "well in the points" and, having seen Verstappen hold off the McLarens and Ferraris, he could feasibly have finished around seventh - where polesitter Gasly did.
So, this was certainly one of those frustrating weekends. - SK
keyPointsZh: 严格来说，安东内利是从第12位（重启发车顺位）而非第19位起步夺冠
比赛中的虚拟安全车进站（virtual safety car pitstop）也是这次胜利的背景因素之一
因为有这些背景，这场胜利不宜列入F1历史上最伟大的从头领先到尾的夺冠之列
keyPointsEn: Strictly speaking, Antonelli started from 12th (on the restart grid) rather than 19th
The virtual safety car pitstop was also part of the context of this victory
Because of these caveats, this win should not be placed among the greatest front-to-back victories in F1 history

detailZh: 意大利大奖赛：梅赛德斯的策略是否让拉塞尔在蒙扎输给了安东内利、丢掉了冠军？
拉塞尔在比赛尾声被安东内利超越，后者在虚拟安全车（Virtual Safety Car）期间进站，采用了不同的策略并追上了自己的队友；从本周五开始，在天空体育F1频道收看马德里新赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛的每一节比赛直播

尽管在一场激动人心的意大利大奖赛中输给了安东内利，拉塞尔仍然认为梅赛德斯采取分岔策略是正确的。
当一场改变比赛走势的虚拟安全车在剩余25圈时出动时，拉塞尔领先安东内利一秒——后者从第19位发起猛攻，仅用13圈就加入了领先集团的争夺。
梅赛德斯为安东内利进站换上了全新的中性胎，但没有让拉塞尔进站，这导致两位队友在虚拟安全车结束时相隔15秒。

从第六位发车，安东内利逐一超越对手，然后在还剩三圈时追上并超越了拉塞尔，赢得了他的主场赛事。
这使得拉塞尔在车手积分榜上落后安东内利66分，赛季还剩下10轮比赛。
拉塞尔说：“当虚拟安全车出现时，我用的是硬胎，而安东内利用的是中性胎，所以如果我们两人中要有人进站，那也只会是安东内利。”
“我想，我之所以对那次虚拟安全车出现的时机有点恼火，是因为就像维斯塔潘说的那样，我认为当时用中性胎的车手很难与任何用硬胎的车手竞争。但这丝毫不能否定安东内利整场比赛的表现。”
当拉塞尔登上蒙扎的领奖台时，人群爆发出针对他的嘘声
如果梅赛德斯让两位车手都进站，安东内利就会在维修区通道里被堵住几秒钟，从而把赛道位置丢给同样在虚拟安全车期间进站的马克斯·维斯塔潘。
拉塞尔对天空体育F1说：“虚拟安全车出现的时间很尴尬。我觉得车队并不清楚什么才是正确的策略，而且因为马克斯当时也在争夺之中，车队决定采取分化的策略，这可能是对车队来说正确的选择。
“当然，事后来看很容易说我当时应该进站，或者如果我赢了比赛，他们又会说基米应该留在场上。
“我本来很想和基米较量一番。那是一场很不错的对抗，而且我觉得当时我顶得挺好。那可能也是车队想让我们采用不同策略的另一个原因。我理解。”
基米·安东内利与拉塞尔在意大利大奖赛上多次进行轮对轮的较量
希夫：我不明白为什么拉塞尔没有更沮丧一些
“说实话，我不明白为什么他没有更沮丧一点。”
"我想，如果你已经全力以赴，并且认为自己确实执行了最佳策略，而你的队友却从发车位的第19位直接击败了你，那么也许就没有什么可沮丧的了，唯一令人感慨的就是，基米这个赛季将会非常难以击败。"
沃尔夫解释梅赛德斯在虚拟安全车时段的思路
托托·沃尔夫透露，在虚拟安全车出现时，梅赛德斯的电脑系统告诉他们，拉塞尔的策略会比安东内利的更快，这名意大利车手预计会"逼近但追不上"。
梅赛德斯认为硬胎是一种"永远耐用"的轮胎，实际上可以坚持整场比赛，但中性胎就达不到这样的表现。
沃尔夫说：“今天决定性的因素是（安东内利）在车流中穿行的能力。我们在过去的其他伟大车手身上也见过这一点。刘易斯（汉密尔顿）在一些比赛中也展现过这种能力，而他今天再次证明了这一点。”
“当车手与赛车融为一体时，就没有任何东西能够阻挡他们。”
乔治·拉塞尔解释了车队为什么在虚拟安全车期间选择不让他进站，而这个决定本可能让他在蒙扎丢掉胜利
进入这个比赛周末之前，人们原本预计安东内利会在积分上被距离他最接近的争冠对手——拉塞尔、刘易斯·汉密尔顿和兰多·诺里斯——追近。
然而相反，他扩大了自己的领先优势，而拉塞尔将在接下来的某一场比赛中从队尾发车，因为他的引擎数量不足以在不接受发车罚退的情况下完成整个赛季。
不过，拉塞尔表示他"没有去想"争冠形势，而是着眼于积极的一面——与夏休期之前的几场比赛相比，车队在蒙扎和赞德福特具备了竞争力。
基米·安东内利回顾了他从第19位发车一路夺冠、在蒙扎上演惊艳表现的惊人胜利，他追上了队友拉塞尔，拿下具有里程碑意义的主场胜利，并扩大了自己在车手总冠军榜上的领先优势。
"我们现在就处在现在的位置。基米这个赛季的表现非常出色，他配得上领跑车手总冠军，而且他有着不小的领先优势，"他说。
"我不会去想那场争夺战或者追赶的事。我只想专注于每一场比赛，努力去赢下它。顺其自然就好。我不会在这方面给自己施加压力，说什么'我必须做到这个或那个'。我只需要赢下更多的比赛，当然，他现在占据着这个位置。"

Highlights from the 2026 Italian Grand Prix
George Russell feels Mercedes were correct to split strategies despite losing out to Kimi Antonelli in a thrilling Italian Grand Prix.
Russell led Antonelli, who stormed through the field from 19th to be in the lead battle after just 13 laps, by one second when a race-changing Virtual Safety Car was called with 25 laps remaining.
Mercedes pitted Antonelli, but not Russell, for new medium tyres, which put the team-mates 15 seconds apart when the VSC ended.

From sixth, Antonelli overtook his rivals one by one then caught and overtook Russell with three laps to go to win his home event.
It leaves Russell 66 points behind Antonelli in the Drivers' Championship with 10 rounds to go.
"I was on the hard tyre and Kimi was on the medium tyre [when the VSC came], so if either of us were to pit, it was going to be Kimi," said Russell.

"I guess, why I was just a little bit annoyed with the timing of that VSC because, like Max said, I think it would have been tough for those guys on the medium to have competed with anybody on the hard tyre. But, it takes nothing away from Kimi's drive altogether."
The crowd erupted with boos aimed at George Russell as he stepped on Monza podium
Had Mercedes pitted both drivers, Antonelli would have been stuck behind for a few seconds in the pit lane, therefore losing track position to Max Verstappen, who also pitted under the VSC.

Russell told Sky Sports F1: "The VSC came at an awkward time. I don't think the team knew what the right strategy was and, as Max was in the fight, decided to split the strategy which was probably the right thing for the team to do.
"In hindsight of course, it's easy to say I should have pitted or, if I won the race, they would have said Kimi should have stayed out.

"I would have liked to have had a fight with Kimi. It was quite a nice battle and I felt I was holding my own at that point. That was probably another reason the team wanted us to go on a different strategy. I get it."
Kimi Antonelli and George Russell go wheel-to-wheel for the Italian Grand Prix several times
Schiff: I don't know why Russell is not more frustrated
"I don’t know why he’s not a little bit more frustrated, if I’m totally honest.

"I guess if you’ve given it all and you think that have actually executed the best strategy, and your team-mate has beaten you outright from P19 on the grid, then maybe there is nothing to be frustrated about, other than the fact that Kimi is going to be incredibly tough to beat this season."
Wolff explains Mercedes' thinking at time of VSC

Toto Wolff revealed Mercedes' computer systems told them, at the time of the VSC, that Russell's strategy would be faster than Antonelli's with the Italian expected to "come close but wouldn't catch".
Mercedes believed the hard tyre was a "forever tyre" that would effectively last the whole race, but not with the performance of the medium.

"The differentiator today was the ability going through the traffic [from Antonelli]. We've seen it with other great ones in the past. Lewis [Hamilton] put it in some of the races and that's what he's shown today," said Wolff.
"There's just no stopping when a driver and a car are one, then there's nothing that can stop them."
George Russell explains why the team chose not to pit him during the VSC, which potentially could have cost him the win in Monza
Coming into the weekend, Antonelli was expected to lose points to his closest title rivals - Russell, Lewis Hamilton and Lando Norris.
Instead, he's extended his advantage and Russell is set to start at the back himself in one of the upcoming races as he does not have enough engines to finish the season without a grid penalty.
However, Russell says he's "not thinking about" the title race and instead is looking at the positives of being competitive in Monza and Zandvoort compared to the events before the summer break.
Kimi Antonelli reflects on his sensational 19th to first Monza victory, catching teammate George Russell to claim a landmark home win and strengthen his championship lead
"We are where we are. Kimi's been driving incredibly this season and deserves to be leading the championship and he's got a healthy lead," he said.

"I'm not going to think about the fight or the comeback. I'm just thinking about going to every race and trying to win it. It will be what it will be. I'm not putting any pressure on myself in this regard, saying 'I need to do this or that'. I just need to win more races and, of course, he's in this spot."

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿批评法拉利缺乏规则
items.summaryZh: 在意大利大奖赛上，刘易斯·汉密尔顿与队友夏尔·勒克莱尔起步后发生碰撞，赛后汉密尔顿对法拉利车队内部缺乏规则表示不满。
items.originalTitle: 汉密尔顿批评法拉利缺乏规则
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton criticized a lack of rules within the Ferrari team after an early collision with teammate Charles Leclerc compromised his Italian Grand Prix.
detailZh: 法拉利一级方程式车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿抨击了车队内部缺乏规则的问题，此前意大利大奖赛因他与队友夏尔·勒克莱尔在早段发生的事故而受到影响。
起步后不久，勒克莱尔对汉密尔顿进入第一弯（Variante del Rettifilo）的迟刹车超越做出回应，试图在弯道第二段守住位置，并在出弯时将汉密尔顿挤到砂石区，导致44号车的名次大幅下滑。
在这场被红旗打断的比赛（红旗由勒克莱尔第二圈的撞车引发）结束时，这件事沉重地压在汉密尔顿心头。他最终以第六名完赛，在旧的中性胎上苦苦挣扎，因为他没有利用虚拟安全车进行一次“免费”的进站，而基米·安东内利和马克斯·维斯塔潘都在他之前完成了这次进站。
对汉密尔顿来说这次进站本来也很勉强——虚拟安全车在安东内利和维斯塔潘驶出维修站后仅几秒就取消了——但仍有可能成功（而且法拉利本也可以在红旗期间干脆为汉密尔顿换上更硬的轮胎）。
勒克莱尔曾表示，一号弯发生的事故双方都有责任，甚至似乎把大部分责任归咎于汉密尔顿。针对他所说的“我们做得太过分了”，汉密尔顿给出了尖锐的回击：“到二号弯时我在前面。到弯心时我在前面。所以这里面没有什么‘我们’。”
当被问到法拉利车迷是否应该担心队友之间的争斗时，他的回答也暗示了对队友比赛方式的不满。
“听着，你知道的，我比赛从来不耍阴招，”他说。“我一直干净、公平地比赛，总是留出空间。所以我认为他们不用担心我。
“我加入车队以来一直努力尊重空间——绝对没有把车队置于危险之中。我坚持这一点，这就是我这边能说的全部。另一方面你得去问弗雷德·瓦塞尔。”
赛后，汉密尔顿与文字媒体的交流时间异常之长，但当被问到法拉利内部是否存在文化问题时，他予以了回击。
“我知道你们这些人想干什么！我不想陷入关于我的车队的争吵和争斗，”他说，“归根结底，我正在竭尽全力去打造这支车队，帮助它达到它需要达到的高度。”
“我们今天表现得不够好。这本已经够痛苦了，没必要再去纠缠我的车手们。他们要回家面对家人。他们真的非常、非常努力。是的，我们今天没有做对。这还不够好。但我们会回到起点重新规划。”
不过，在此之前他非常明确地表达了对贴身缠斗（轮对轮较量）没有得到约束的不满——而且，就像他在荷兰大奖赛后以及周六排位赛后所做的那样，他再次暗示车队没有为他的争冠征程投入足够的力量。
“现在才做那些决定已经太晚了，晚了很多很多个星期。所以，我能做的就是尽力出现在赛场上。”他若有所思地说。
这个周末汉密尔顿遇到了一些与勒克莱尔无关的操作性问题——不过周六他也明确表达了对勒克莱尔那侧车库的不满，因为对方的一个二段排位赛（Q2）运行计划妨碍了他自己的成绩。
当被《The 比赛》问到法拉利在操作层面丢分的问题时，他说：“归根结底这来自于高层。决策是自上而下层层传导的，所以一切要从瓦塞尔开始。”
“你能说的、能在山顶上呐喊和推动的东西终究有限。昨天（周六）我说过，我们必须审视我们的沟通方式，因为如果我们继续沿着同样的路走下去，就会得到同样的结果。”
"就是说，我们一直在得到同样的结果。我们必须做出改变，因为这对我们前进没有帮助。我认为他们是愿意接受的，我们会把这件事放到私下里讨论……可能不是下周，尤其是在下一场比赛之后，试图研究我们在流程上如何以不同的方式做事，这样同样的情况就不会一再发生。"
当谈到如何为他的争冠之路排定优先次序时，他表示重点不是让勒克莱尔让位，而是要避免类似第一个减速弯（chicane）处所发生的那种局面。
"我认为关键在于交战规则。当我在梅赛德斯的时候，我们有一份书面的交战规则。我们从没闹得特别僵。我和尼科（罗斯伯格）之间也许有过几次小摩擦。但大多数时候都很好，我是说，尤其是和瓦尔特利（博塔斯）之间……"
在他与媒体的书面访谈环节时，瓦塞尔表示他还没有和勒克莱尔详细讨论发车时的事故——而和汉密尔顿只谈了"两秒钟"。当被问及他的看法时，他坚持说："我更愿意先和他们讨论，而不是先和你们讨论。"
关于在虚拟安全车期间不进站的策略，他说：“在虚拟安全车出现前后，我们与马克斯的差距是一样的。”这里指的是一个事实：当兰斯·斯特罗尔因液压故障触发虚拟安全车时，汉密尔顿落后维斯塔潘约六到七秒，而最终比赛结束时他落后维斯塔潘10秒。
“但就我们的情况来说，如果进站，你会落在（角田裕毅）和（皮埃尔·加斯利）身后，我不确定你是否能超过他们，”瓦塞尔补充道，不过乍看之下，汉密尔顿几乎百分之百肯定能超过小红牛的赛车，而且极有可能也能重新超过加斯利。
至于赛前是否与车手们谈及争夺总冠军的形势，瓦塞尔说：“关于是否要有车队指令之类的安排，我想我能做出的最好比较是：上赛季这个时候，（奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里）正领跑迈凯伦。如果迈凯伦当时把一切都押在皮亚斯特里身上，那么马克斯·维斯塔潘就会是总冠军了。”
“但可以肯定的是，到了某个阶段，你必须做出决定。不过我认为在蒙扎之前就做决定还为时过早。现在我们有时间和车手们好好讨论了。”
汉密尔顿落后领跑车手总冠军的安东内利76分，勒克莱尔落后安东内利112分——而本赛季剩余比赛最多还有258分可以争夺。
detailEn: Ferrari Formula 1 driver Lewis Hamilton has hit out at a lack of rules within the team, following an Italian Grand Prix compromised by an early incident with team-mate Charles Leclerc.

Moments after the start, Leclerc responded to a Hamilton divebomb into Variante del Rettifilo by trying to keep position through the second part of the corner and crowding Hamilton out into the gravel on exit, which dropped the #44 car well down the order.

It weighed heavily on Hamilton's mind at the conclusion of the red flag-disrupted race (the flag triggered by Leclerc's lap-two crash), as he trundled home in sixth, struggling on used mediums after not taking a 'free' virtual safety car pitstop that both Kimi Antonelli and Max Verstappen were able to make ahead of him.

It would have been marginal for Hamilton - the VSC was lifted only a few seconds after Antonelli and Verstappen headed out of the pits - but it may have been possible (and Ferrari could have also simply fitted the harder tyre for Hamilton during the red flag).

Leclerc had suggested a joint responsibility for what happened at Turn 1, even seemingly placing most of the blame on Hamilton. In response to his claim that "we went too far", Hamilton offered a sharp rebuke: "I was ahead in Turn 2. By the apex, I was ahead. So there was no 'we' in it."
He also alluded to a dissatisfaction with his team-mate's approach to racing with his answer to the question of whether Ferrari fans should fear a team-mate feud.
"Look, you know, I don't race dirty," he said. "I've always raced clean and fairly and always left space. So I don't think they should be worried about me.

"I've come into the team and tried to be respectful of space - and definitely not put the team in jeopardy. I stand by that and that's all I can talk about, on my side. You have to speak to Fred [Vasseur] about the other side."
Hamilton spoke to the written press for an unusually long time in the aftermath of the race, though pushed back when asked whether there was a cultural issue at play at Ferrari.

"I know what you guys are trying to do! I don't want to get into arguing and fighting about my team," he said. "At the end of the day, I'm trying my hardest to make this team and help this team get to where it needs to be.

"We didn't do so well today. It's painful enough as it is, to be badgering my guys. They go home to their families. They're working really, really hard. Yes, we didn't get it right today. It isn't good enough. But we'll go back to the drawing table."

However, before that he very clearly expressed a dissatisfaction with the wheel-to-wheel racing not being reined in - and again, as he had done after the Dutch GP and after Saturday's qualifying, indicated that not enough weight had been thrown behind his title campaign.
"It's far too late for that, for those decisions to come. It's many, many weeks too late. So, all I can do is just try and turn up," he mused.

There were operational problems for Hamilton through this weekend independent of Leclerc - though he was also pointedly unhappy with Leclerc's side of the garage on Saturday over a Q2 run plan that hindered his own.
Asked by The Race about Ferrari losing points operationally, he said: "Ultimately it comes from the top. It trickles down decisions - and so, it starts with Fred.

"There's only so much you can say, so much you can push and shout from the mountaintop. Yesterday [Saturday] I said we've got to look at just how we communicate because if we continue to travel the same path, we get the same result.

"It's like, we keep getting the same result. We've got to change things because this is not helping us move forwards. I think they're receptive to it and we'll take it offline over the next...probably not for next week, but particularly after next race to try and look how we can procedurally do things different so the same thing can't keep happening."
And when it came to prioritising his title charge, he said it wasn't about moving Leclerc over but just avoiding situations like what transpired at the first chicane.

"I think it comes down to rules of engagement. When I was at Mercedes, we had a written rule of engagement. We never really, really had too bad. There was a moment maybe with me and Nico [Rosberg] a couple of times. But more often than not it was good, I mean, [especially with] Valtteri [Bottas]...

At the time of his written media session, Vasseur said he had not yet talked through the start incident with Leclerc - and just for "two seconds" with Hamilton. "I prefer to discuss with them first than with you first," he insisted when asked for his view.

On the no-stop under VSC, he said: "We had the same gap with Max before and after the VSC." This is in reference to the fact Hamilton trailed Verstappen by around six-to-seven seconds when Lance Stroll's hydraulic failure brought out the VSC, and ended up 10 seconds back from Verstappen at the finish.

"But in our case, if you pit you are behind [Yuki] Tsunoda and [Pierre] Gasly, I'm not sure that you are able to overtake them," Vasseur added, though at first glance it appears 100% certain Hamilton would've cleared the Racing Bulls, and also extremely likely he would've got back past Gasly.

As for whether the championship picture was raised with the drivers pre-race, Vasseur said: "To see if we have a team order or whatever, I think that the good comparison that I made was that last year, [Oscar] Piastri was leading [for] McLaren at this stage of the season. And if McLaren put everything on Piastri, Max Verstappen would have been champion.
"But for sure, at one stage, you have to take a decision. But I think it was too early to take a decision before Monza. Now we have time to discuss with the guys."
Hamilton trails championship leader Kimi Antonelli by 76 points, with Leclerc 112 off Antonelli - and a maximum total of 258 available over the rest of the season.

items.summaryEn: At the Italian Grand Prix, Kimi Antonelli started from the back of the grid and won after being the only Mercedes driver to pit, beating his team-mate George Russell. Mercedes said it was unsure which strategy was better when the virtual safety car appeared, so Russell stayed out.
detailZh: 为什么梅赛德斯没有在意大利大奖赛虚拟安全车出动时让乔治·拉塞尔进站："我们不知道哪种策略更好"

基米·安东内利在意大利大奖赛上从发车区末位惊人夺冠，这要归功于出色的驾驶表现，但或许也得益于策略上的一点帮助以及一次及时出动的虚拟安全车。
这位意大利车手是比赛中唯一进站的梅赛德斯车手——并最终击败了他的队友和总冠军竞争对手乔治·拉塞尔。
梅赛德斯为两位车手制定了不同的策略，在早段的红旗之后让安东内利换上了中性胎。这位意大利车手起步时使用的是硬胎，这是他能够不进站跑完全程的唯一选择。而拉塞尔起步时使用中性胎，在夏尔·勒克莱尔撞车导致比赛暂停后换上了硬胎，并在剩余的赛程中一直使用这款轮胎。
对于安东内利，梅赛德斯利用了第27圈兰斯·斯特罗尔停车引发虚拟安全车的机会，让他换上了一套全新的中性胎。
到那时为止，安东内利已经完成了场上的超车，并与拉塞尔争夺领先位置——不过梅赛德斯要求他在对抗的初始阶段之后不要攻击自己的队友，以便让两人尝试拉开与马克斯·维斯塔潘的差距。
随后车队召唤安东内利进站。尽管这位意大利车手最终凭借更新的轮胎追回来并超越了队友，但梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫表示，车队自己也不清楚哪种策略最终会证明更为有效。
“我们当时不知道哪种策略更好，”他在赛后接受包括Motorsport.com在内的媒体采访时说。“在那个阶段，系统显示一次停站（针对拉塞尔）会更有优势。两次停站到比赛尾声会追近一些，但追不上。所以软件是这么说的。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
“把两种策略分开也是正确的做法，因为不知道哪种更好。在早上的会议上我们就说过硬胎可以撑很久。你可以用它起步再用它完赛，你可以看到拉塞尔的情况，那是一条能撑到底的轮胎，但它的性能不如中性胎。”
尽管安东内利报告说他的轮胎状态良好，车队还是做出了让他进站的决定。
“我们没有和基米谈论进站的事，”沃尔夫确认道。“我们询问了轮胎的状况，他说‘嗯，其实状态不错’，但很明显我们看到了轮胎磨损，而且我记得是在刘易斯的车上看到的。我们也在一辆迈凯伦上看到了一些磨损。所以这样做是正确的。也正因如此，这不需要什么大的讨论。
“但话虽如此，安东内利能够以稳定的方式从那条轮胎上跑出35圈甚至40圈，这确实是他的本事。”
拉塞尔本人相信，如果安东内利当时采用同样的策略，他有足够的速度赢得这场比赛。
“我本来很希望继续使用同一套策略，”他在赛后新闻发布会上说道。“因为我觉得自己在这场缠斗中处于有利位置。我很清楚在能量管理方面需要怎么做来防守，也知道什么时候该进攻、完成那些超越动作，为此我在赛前做了大量准备。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯；乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
"然后当然，当虚拟安全车出动的时候，它正好出现在让车手们可以果断行动、进站换胎的完美时机。"
当被问到他当时是否考虑过进站换上新轮胎时，拉塞尔说："我没有。我当时其实以为我身后的车手们也会留在赛道上不进站，不过我相信车队在维修区控制墙上看着我们的缠斗时一定相当紧张，他们大概也很乐意让我们采用不同的策略。"
"从车队的角度来看，当马克斯也混在战局之中的时候，你需要同时应对两种情况。所以，今天基米做得非常出色。"
"我当时用的是硬胎，而基米用的是中性胎。所以如果我们俩中有人要进站的话，那也只会是基米。这就是为什么我对虚拟安全车（VSC）出现的时机有点恼火，因为我认为用中性胎的那些车手想和任何用硬胎的车手抗衡都会很困难。"
"但是，这丝毫不能抹杀基米整场比赛的表现。如果没有虚拟安全车（VSC），比赛会如何发展本来会非常有意思。"
在蒙扎的比赛结束后，拉塞尔在积分榜上落后安东内利66分。
detailEn: Why Mercedes didn't pit George Russell under virtual safety car in Italian GP: "We didn't know which strategy was better"
Toto Wolff revealed Mercedes' software predicted George Russell would still win the race on his strategy
Kimi Antonelli's sensational win from the back of the grid in the Italian Grand Prix was thanks to a great drive, but perhaps also a little help from strategy and a timely virtual safety car.
The Italian was the only Mercedes driver to make a pitstop during the race - and ultimately defeated his team-mate and championship rival George Russell.

Mercedes split the strategies between its drivers, putting Antonelli on mediums after the early red flag. That was the only option for the Italian to go to the end without stopping, having started the race on hards. Russell, on the other hand, started on mediums and switched to hards after the race was stopped following Charles Leclerc's crash - and stayed on that tyre for the rest of the distance.
For Antonelli, Mercedes used the opportunity to put him on a new set of mediums when Lance Stroll's stoppage caused a virtual safety car on lap 27.

By that point, Antonelli had already made his way through the field and was battling Russell for the lead - although Mercedes asked him not to attack his team-mate after the initial phase of the fight, allowing them to try to build a gap to Max Verstappen.

Then came the call for Antonelli to pit. And although the Italian was able to come back and overtake his team-mate on fresher tyres, Mercedes boss Toto Wolff said the team itself didn't know which strategy would ultimately prove better.

“We didn't know what was the better strategy," he told the media, including Motorsport.com, after the race. "At that stage, the system said that the one-stop [for Russell] comes out ahead. That two-stop was coming close to the end, but wouldn't catch. So that's what the software said.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes

“It was also the right thing to split the strategies because it was unknown what the better one would be. In the morning meeting we said the hard tyre is going to go forever. You can start on it and finish on it and you can see with George it was a forever tyre but it didn't have the performance that of the medium.”
The decision to stop Antonelli was made despite him reporting that his tyres were in good shape.

“We didn't talk to Kimi about the stop," Wolff confirmed. "We asked for the state of the tyre and he said, 'Well it's actually good' but it was clear that we saw abrasion and I think it was on Lewis' car. We saw some abrasion on a McLaren. So it was the right thing to do. And that's why it didn't need any big discussion.
“But then having said that, Kimi was able to extract 35 laps or 40 laps from that tyre in a consistent way and that's certainly his skill.”
Russell himself believes he had enough pace to win the race had Antonelli stayed on the same strategy.

"I would have loved to have continued on the same strategy," he said during the post-race press conference. "Because I felt in a good position in that battle. I knew exactly what I needed to do with the energy management to defend but also when to attack and make those moves and I put a lot of preparation into this race in that regard.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes
"Then of course when the VSC came out, it came out at that perfect point for the drivers to pull the trigger and take the pitstop."

Asked whether he had considered stopping for fresh rubber at that point, Russell said: "I didn't. I actually thought the guys behind me were going to stay out as well but I'm sure the team were quite nervous on the pitwall watching our battle and were probably quite happy to send us on different strategies.
"When we had Max in the mix as well from a team perspective, you're covering off both scenarios. So, today Kimi did a great job.

"I was on the hard tyre and Kimi was on the medium tyre. So if either of us were to pit, it was going to be Kimi. And that's why I was just a little bit annoyed with the timing of that VSC, because I think it would have been tough for those guys on the medium to have competed with anybody on the hard tyre.
"But, it takes nothing away from Kimi's drive altogether. It would have been very interesting to see how the race would have panned out if there was no VSC."
After the race at Monza, Russell trails Antonelli by 66 points in the championship.

items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver George Russell says he is not even thinking about an F1 title comeback, as Kimi Antonelli's 66-point advantage will be tough to overcome.
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔 "甚至不去想" F1冠军逆袭，基米·安东内利 "掌控局势"
梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔在意大利大奖赛上被基米·安东内利击败后，基本上已在车队内部的F1冠军争夺战中举起了白旗
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔表示，他"甚至不去想"F1冠军逆袭，因为他承认基米·安东内利66分的领先优势将很难被追回。
随着安东内利在蒙扎从第19位发车，而拉塞尔位居第二，这位英国车手迎来了缩小与意大利对手59分差距的绝佳机会。但安东内利迅速提升了名次，在第6圈比赛重启后跃升至第六位，并以此为契机向拉塞尔的冠军位置发起挑战。
在第19圈首次超越拉塞尔并几次互换位置后，安东内利利用虚拟安全车以低成本进站换上新的中性胎，并在53圈的比赛中末段拉塞尔的硬胎开始衰退时追近了他。
安东内利的逆转夺冠是他本赛季的第七场大奖赛胜利，使这位20岁车手的冠军积分领先优势扩大到66分，而不是不得不限制拉塞尔追回任何分数。
这一巨大打击似乎让拉塞尔进入了接受现实的阶段，他承认在接下来10场大奖赛中追上他的意大利队友将是一项艰巨的任务。
"是啊，Kimi 肯定掌控着局面，而且他配得上掌控局面," Russell 承认道。"我甚至没有想过什么战斗或反击之类的事情。我只是专注于一场一场比赛地打，努力把每个周末都发挥到极致。"
"他的表现非常出色。要弥补那个差距将会异常艰难，所以我就接受现实吧。从现在开始我只想享受比赛，尽可能多地赢下比赛。"
安东内利, 梅赛德斯, 拉塞尔, 梅赛德斯
Russell 对梅赛德斯采取不同策略并无异议，因为他以中性胎起步，然后在比赛的大部分时间里换上了硬胎。
由于不得不从队列后方发车，安东内利选择了硬胎，并在红旗期间换上了中性胎。安东内利看起来很可能陷入两难：要么让这套轮胎撑到比赛结束，要么在没有虚拟安全车帮助的情况下挑战拉塞尔——虚拟安全车为他提供了一个代价更低的进站机会。
“嗯，（硬胎）绝对是撑到比赛结束的最佳选择，”拉塞尔说。
“当我看到维斯塔潘和基米用中性胎的时候，我感觉相当不错，因为我知道他们的轮胎衰减会比我更严重，所以在比赛的中段，我对自己的位置非常满意。”
“虚拟安全车在完美的时机出现，让车手们得以果断进站。如果没有虚拟安全车，比赛会如何发展，那将会非常有趣。”
detailEn: George Russell "not even thinking" of F1 title comeback as Kimi Antonelli "in control"
Mercedes driver George Russell has all but waved the white flag in his intra-team Formula 1 title battle after being beaten by Kimi Antonelli at the Italian Grand Prix
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes
Mercedes driver George Russell says he is "not even thinking" about a Formula 1 title comeback as his accepting Kimi Antonelli's 66-point advantage will be tough to overcome.

With Antonelli starting 19th in Monza and Russell second, the Briton had a golden opportunity to eat into his 59-point deficit to the Italian. But Antonelli swiftly moved up the order, vaulting up to sixth after the lap 6 restart and used that as a springboard to challenge Russell for the win.

After initially passing Russell on lap 19 and trading places a few more times, Antonelli used a virtual safety car to make a cheap pitstop for new medium tyres, reeling in hard-tyre running Russell when the latter's tyres started fading at the end of the 53-lap race.
Antonelli's comeback win was his seventh grand prix victory of the season, increasing the 20-year-old's title lead to 66 points rather than having to limit any damage to Russell.
That huge blow appeared to knock Russell into the acceptance stage, acknowledging that catching his Italian team-mate over the next 10 grands prix will be a tall order.

"Yeah, Kimi's definitely in control of it and he's deserving to be in control of it," Russell admitted. "I'm not even thinking about a fight or a comeback or anything. I'm just focused on taking it race by race and trying to maximise every single weekend.

"He's performing incredibly well. It's going to be exceptionally challenging to overcome that gap, so I'm just sort of accepting that is what it is. I'm just going to enjoy it from here on in and try and win as many races as possible."
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes
Russell saw no bones in Mercedes splitting its strategies as he had started on medium tyres and then moved to the hard tyres for the majority of the race.

Having to start down the order, Antonelli opted for the hard compound instead, moving to mediums under the red flag. Antonelli looked set to struggle to either bring those tyres to the end, or challenge Russell without the benefit of a virtual safety car which gave him a less costly opportunity to pit.
"Well, [the hard] was definitely the best tyre to take to the end," Russell said.

"When I saw Max [Verstappen] and Kimi on the medium, I was feeling pretty good because I knew they were going to drop off more than me, so in that middle stage of the race, I was really happy with my position.
"The VSC came out at that perfect point for the drivers to pull the trigger and take the pitstop. It would have been very interesting to see how the race would have panned out if there was no VSC."

detailZh: 弗朗哥·科拉平托赛后落泪，一次“重大失误”让他失去了在意大利大奖赛冲击前列的机会
这位阿根廷车手在意大利大奖赛第二次发车后一度升至第三位，但随后一次失误使他冲出赛道，名次大幅下滑
弗朗哥·科拉平托在意大利大奖赛中一度处于领跑集团，但一次失误终结了他争夺领奖台的希望，不过他最终恢复状态以第九名完赛，为阿尔派车队挽回了一些积分。
这位阿尔派车手从第七位发车，由于夏尔·勒克莱尔与刘易斯·汉密尔顿发生事故导致后者名次大跌，科拉平托在发车后上升了一个位置。随后当勒克莱尔在第二圈末段撞车时，他又上升一位，并在片刻之后超越了奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，但不久之后比赛便出示了红旗。
第二次起步时，科拉平托排在第四位发车，并立即向马克斯·维斯塔潘发起进攻，在第一个减速弯超过了这位红牛车手，一度升至第三位。维斯塔潘在通往罗贾变线弯的直道上予以反击，重新夺回了位置。
但仅仅几米之后，科拉平托驾驶的阿尔派赛车在莱斯莫弯失控冲入砂石区，名次一路跌至第16位。
“我有一个绝佳的机会，但我没有抓住，所以我很难过，真的非常难过。我觉得这本可以是一场很棒的比赛，而那是一个重大失误。我错失了一个对车队和我自己都非常重要的机会，所以我为此感到有些伤心。从中吸取教训是很艰难的，”赛后泪流满面的科拉平托在接受阿根廷ESPN采访时说道。
这位年轻的阿根廷车手上周刚被官宣将继续留在阿尔派征战2027赛季，稍后在蒙扎面对包括《赛车运动》网站（Motorsport.com）在内的平面媒体时，他依然难掩沮丧之情。
“我只是很沮丧。我觉得我做了不少不错的东西，”科拉平托说。“我也不知道，我就在5-6号弯完全失去了对赛车的控制，有点莫名其妙，非常令人沮丧。我觉得我们本来可以做出一些好成绩，P2和P3近在眼前，你感觉自己状态很强，突然之间就在和顶尖车队较量，你会很快变得非常有动力，而一个这样的失误就把一切都抛掉了，我只是很沮丧。
“我还不太明白到底发生了什么。赛车非常猛烈地失去了抓地力，我高速冲过了碎石区，赛车受损很严重，我以为不得不退赛了，然后我们又重新跑了上去，我们用工具对赛车做了一些调整，把所有东西稍微封闭起来，让赛车的空气阻力稍微变大了一些，是的，最终成功拿到了积分。
争夺领奖台的战斗本来就很难持续下去，正如他在阿尔派的队友皮埃尔·加斯利所展示的那样。加斯利从杆位发车，但最终只获得第七名。然而，这丝毫没有减轻科拉平托的沮丧情绪。
“只是对没有最大化发挥赛车性能以及我们一起做的那些不错的工作感到沮丧，是的，我觉得就为未来吸取教训吧，”他说。“但我们在前面、在领先集团战斗的机会并不多，出现这样的时刻格外令人沮丧。我觉得我们本应该拿到更多积分，所以要对车队说声抱歉，希望我们在马德里能做得更好。
当Motorsport.com问及他超越四届世界冠军维斯塔潘的那次超车时，科拉平托淡化了这次动作的意义，同时承认这恰恰凸显了他们错失了多少机会。
"我认为当你坐在车里的时候，其实感觉不到是和这一个还是另一个较量的区别，但和他们战斗感觉很酷，"他说。"这就是我之前想表达的意思，能和顶级赛车、顶级车队并排争夺，我们平时真的做不到。所以就这样错过这样一个机会，非常痛苦。"
detailEn: Franco Colapinto in tears after a “big mistake” cost him a shot at the front in Italian GP
The Argentine had risen to third at the second start of the Italian Grand Prix before a mistake sent him off track and dropped him down the order

Franco Colapinto was running at the sharp end of the field in the Italian Grand Prix before a mistake ended his hopes of fighting for a podium, although he recovered to finish ninth and salvage points for Alpine.

The Alpine driver started seventh and gained a place at the start after an incident involving Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton sent the latter tumbling down the order. Colapinto then moved up another position when Leclerc crashed at the end of the second lap before overtaking Oscar Piastri moments later, only for the race to be red-flagged shortly afterwards.

Colapinto lined up fourth for the second start and immediately made his move on Max Verstappen, passing the Red Bull driver into the first chicane to briefly move up to third. Verstappen hit back on the run down to the Variante della Roggia, retaking the position.
But just metres later, Colapinto lost control of his Alpine through the Lesmo corner and ran into the gravel, dropping all the way down to 16th.

"I had a great opportunity and I didn't take it, so I'm sad, really sad about that. I think it could have been a great race, and that was a big mistake. I missed a very important opportunity for the team and for myself, so I'm a bit sad about that. Learning from this is difficult," a tearful Colapinto told ESPN Argentina after the race.

The young Argentine, who was announced last week as continuing with Alpine for the 2027 season, was still visibly frustrated when he later spoke to the written press in Monza, including Motorsport.com.

"I'm just frustrated. I think I did some good stuff," Colapinto said. "I don't know, I just lost the car completely in Turn 5-6, a bit out of nowhere, it's very frustrating. I think we could have done some good things, P2 and P3 together, and you feel so strong and suddenly fighting with the top teams, you get very motivated very quickly, and a mistake like that, it throws all away, and I'm just frustrated.

"I don't really understand yet what happened. I lost the car very aggressively, I went very fast through the gravel, I had a lot of damage, I thought I was going to have to retire, and then we started to go again, we changed the car a bit with the tools, we closed everything up a little bit and made the car slightly more draggy again, and yeah, managed to score points."

A podium battle was always going to be difficult to sustain, as his Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly demonstrated. Gasly started from pole but ultimately finished seventh. That, however, did little to ease Colapinto's frustration.

"Just frustrated with not maximising the car and the good stuff that we were doing together, and yeah, I think just learn for the future," he said. "But we don't get many of these opportunities fighting up there and at the front, and it's extra frustrating to have moments like this. I think we should have scored more points, so, sorry to the team, and hopefully we can do better in Madrid."

Asked by Motorsport.com about his pass on four-time world champion Verstappen, Colapinto played down the significance of the move, while acknowledging that it underlined just how much had slipped away.

"I think when you're in the car you don't really feel the difference if it's one or another, but it was cool to be fighting with them," he said. "That's what I meant [before], and to be fighting side-by-side with the top cars and the top teams, we cannot really do it. And so to just miss an opportunity like this, it's very painful."

items.summaryEn: Sky Sports F1 pundit Naomi Schiff hailed Kimi Antonelli's victory from 19th on the grid at the Italian Grand Prix, saying it cements his status as a "generational talent" and warning the young Italian could become unstoppable in the championship battle.
detailZh: 安东内利在意大利大奖赛主场夺冠后被称为"划时代的天才"
Naomi Schiff称赞安东内利是"划时代的天才"，这位梅赛德斯车手在主场意大利大奖赛上从第19位一路冲锋夺得冠军
天空体育F1评论员Naomi Schiff认为，安东内利在意大利大奖赛上的惊人胜利巩固了他作为"划时代的天才"的地位，并警告说这位年轻的意大利人在冠军争夺战中可能变得势不可挡
这位20岁的梅赛德斯车手在蒙扎的主场赛道上奉献了一场令人印象深刻的表现。从发车格第19位起步，Antonelli在车阵中一路突围，并利用比赛中段的虚拟安全车时机换上了全新的中性胎。
随后他追上了当时领先比赛、仍使用较旧硬胎的队友拉塞尔，最终在热情的法拉利车迷面前夺得冠军。
"今天，所有人都对安东内利的表现印象深刻。而且很显然，能有一位像他这样的本土英雄，他今天清楚地证明了自己是那种世代难得的天才，" Schiff解释道。
"我是说，他不仅一路从后方追赶上来，而且在那次进站之后，他还得再次缩小差距，而他做到了。他在主场夺得了胜利。太不可思议了。"
她还补充道："他用了大约六七圈才追到George身后。显然，George和Max一开始也在激烈争夺。然后我心里就有一种感觉，像是在想，'天哪，如果George这时候看一眼后视镜，发现他的队友已经追到他身后了，哦天哪，那一刻我自己都会有点沉不住气。'"
在仅仅参加F1的第二个赛季中，Antonelli在中国大奖赛和日本大奖赛连续夺冠后，成为领跑积分榜的最年轻车手。从那以后，他在夏休期前又获得了四场大奖赛胜利，而他的意大利大奖赛冠军标志着他职业生涯的第七场胜利。
Antonelli目前以领先队友Russell 66分的优势位居车手积分榜榜首。
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli labelled "generational talent" after Italian GP home win
Naomi Schiff has hailed Kimi Antonelli as a “generational talent” after the Mercedes driver charged from 19th to victory at his home Italian Grand Prix

Sky Sports Formula 1 pundit Naomi Schiff believes Kimi Antonelli's spectacular victory at the Italian Grand Prix cements his status as a "generational talent", warning that the young Italian could become unstoppable in the championship battle.

The 20-year-old Mercedes driver delivered an impressive performance on home soil at Monza. Starting from 19th on the grid, Antonelli carved through the field and capitalised on a mid-race virtual safety car to switch to fresh medium tyres.
He subsequently hunted down his race-leading team-mate George Russell, who had remained on older hard tyres, to claim the win in front of the passionate Tifosi.
"Today, everybody is so impressed by what Kimi Antonelli has done. And obviously, to have a home hero like him who clearly proved today the generational talent that he is," Schiff explained.
"I mean, not only did he climb through the field, but then after that pitstop, he had to close up that gap again, and he just did it. And he took the victory here at home. Incredible."

She added: "It took him about six or seven laps before he was behind George. Obviously, George and Max were going at it as well in the beginning. And then I just had a feeling in my heart like, 'Oh gosh, if George looks in the mirrors now and realises his team-mate is already behind him, oh my God, I would have sunk a little bit in that moment.'"

In only his second season in F1, Antonelli became the youngest driver to lead the standings after back-to-back wins at the Chinese and Japanese Grands Prix. From there, he went on to secure four more grand prix wins before the summer break, and his Italian Grand Prix win marks his seventh career victory.
Antonelli now leads the championship with a 66-point advantage over his team-mate Russell.

detailZh: 在基米·安东内利赢得意大利大奖赛之后，F1 世界冠军之争是否已经结束了？我们的撰稿人们各有看法
在安东内利惊艳赢得意大利大奖赛之后，他在 F1 世界锦标赛中的领先优势扩大到了 66 分……
基米·安东内利在意大利大奖赛上从发车区第 19 位发车并最终夺冠，这是一场宣言式的表现，并将他在世界一级方程式锦标赛中的领先优势扩大到 66 分。
在最多还剩 10 站比赛的情况下——具体取决于卡塔尔和阿布扎比大奖赛以及中东局势——这位意大利车手已经处于极其有利的位置，有望锁定 2026 年的世界冠军。
那么，2026年F1世界冠军之争就此结束了吗？我们的专栏作者们各抒己见。
要从现在开始丢掉冠军，安东内利得出现一代人才会遇到的大崩盘才有可能
我不想在欧洲赛段结束之前就断言一切已成定局，但这一站感觉意义非凡。从发车位的第19位一路杀到夺冠，而且击败的是像拉塞尔和维斯塔潘这样领跑车群的车手，这将被载入史册，成为安东内利首次向世人展示其F1世界冠军实力的一刻。
还剩大约10轮比赛，落后66分的差距并非无法逆转——只要他遭遇两次退赛，压力就会立刻压到这位20岁车手的头上——但他似乎丝毫没有被这些影响，甚至可以说，他现在的表现比他在F1崭露头角的职业生涯中的任何时候都要出色。
安东内利已经证明，他可以在需要时稳稳拿下好成绩，也能在胜利近在眼前时全力冲击冠军；这个周末在蒙扎，他实际上连续做到了这两件事。
是的，尽管每场比赛都输给拉塞尔只拿第二，这在数学上还不能确保锁定冠军，但由于他的队友预计将在阿塞拜疆因更换引擎而接受从发车末位起步的处罚，他有一个绝佳的机会把这种局面变成现实。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯；乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
悬念还没结束——但拉塞尔将需要一些运气
安东内利在蒙扎确实给了拉塞尔争冠希望一记重击，但截至今天，还剩下10场比赛——仍有258分可以争取。
拉塞尔的落后已经扩大到66分，而且形势对他不利，他的沮丧情绪可以理解地会不断累积——尽管周日的失利中他表现得非常大度。
要弥补如此巨大的差距，拉塞尔需要天时地利人和全都到位。安东内利很少有失手的比赛；本赛季至今的13场大奖赛中，他有11次登上领奖台，而拉塞尔只有7次。
这种惊人的稳定性通常会导致世界冠军的诞生，很少有反例。巧合的是，反例就发生在去年。奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在前13轮比赛中同样是11次登台，当时他领先队友兰多·诺里斯16分，领先马克斯·维斯塔潘81分，但最终他的得分却被两人反超。
除此之外，最近一次这样的情况是尼科·罗斯伯格在2014年创造的。这位德国车手在赛季前13场比赛中登上了11次领奖台，但队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿自己也拿到了10次领奖台，并且积分榜上只落后22分。换句话说，只有当前差距的三分之一不到。
所以，这样的追赶并非没有先例，维斯塔潘就证明过这一点——但那次的情形并不可比，因为拉塞尔和安东内利开的是同一辆车，而去年红牛车手和迈凯伦车手则不同。因此，虽然还有希望，但这位英国车手如今确实希望渺茫。
在安东内利赢得蒙扎站冠军之后，几乎已经没有什么能阻止他夺得今年的总冠军了。如果之前还有人怀疑，这个周末大概已经消除了预测其他结果的一切理由——除非这位意大利车手在赛道之外出了大问题。
毕竟，伊萨克·哈德贾尔也并不是计划好要缺席几场比赛的。所以，只要安东内利在接下来的几个月里远离拳击手套，他应该就没问题。只要他能出现在发车区——显然，无论从哪个位置发车——他看起来都将在20岁那年成为世界冠军。
而且这不仅仅是关于安东内利的事。拉塞尔作为他目前最接近的竞争对手，不仅要弥合巨大的积分差距——他还必须做到一件更难的事：保持自己仍然能在任何一个比赛周末击败安东内利的信念。
考虑到本赛季的走势，以及这位意大利车手进步的速度，这位英国车手看到自己的年轻队友变得如此出色，心里一定感到非常胆怯。
蒙扎也证实了法拉利很可能已经出局。夏尔·勒克莱尔其实从来都没真正参与争冠，而现在他落后太多，已经无法认真考虑冠军了。而汉密尔顿看上去也没有一辆能够持续挑战梅赛德斯车手们的赛车。同样的情况也适用于诺里斯和迈凯伦，他们车队本周末的弱点再次暴露无遗。
我真的看不到拉塞尔还有任何翻盘的可能。真的看不到。是的，还有很多积分可以争取，一级方程式历史上也发生过更离奇的事情，而且那些强大的梅赛德斯动力单元一直像是玻璃大炮（表面强大实则脆弱）。这些我都明白。
但安东内利取胜的方式，以及在梅赛德斯不处于惯常统治地位时拿到任何一个可得成绩的表现，对于一个20岁的车手来说是相当了不起的。
拉塞尔正在扭转局面，但即便如此，似乎也不足以经常战胜安东内利，而这正是他必须做到的事。不是像他现在大致做到的那样跟上节奏，而是要彻底压倒安东内利。
我只是觉得这不会发生，因为恐怕拉塞尔已经在这位年轻的意大利车手身上遇到了对手。
更重要的是，意大利大奖赛本应是安东内利的一次缓冲，是他启用补救机会（joker）的一场比赛——启用第五套动力单元本应是一场止损行动。结果他非但没有受损，反而给了拉塞尔一记心理上的重击。与此同时，拉塞尔之后仍然要接受引擎处罚，而且剩下的赛道中没有一条会像这里这样容易超车。
去年冠军争夺战的结局表明，10场比赛是一段漫长的时间，但那时是这一代最优秀的车手在后面追赶。而现在，是下一代最优秀的车手跑在最前面，而且他看起来无懈可击。我就在这里下结论。
detailEn: After Kimi Antonelli’s Italian GP win, is the F1 world title fight over? Our writers have their say
Following Antonelli’s stunning Italian GP victory, his F1 world championship lead is up to 66 points…
Kimi Antonelli’s Italian Grand Prix win from 19th on the grid was a statement performance and extends his lead in the Formula 1 world championship to 66 points.
With a maximum of 10 rounds left – subject to the Qatar and Abu Dhabi GPs and the situation in the Middle East – the Italian driver is in a supremely strong position to seal the 2026 world title.
So, is the 2026 F1 world title fight over? Our writers have their say.
It’d need to be a generational choke for Antonelli to lose it from here

I don’t want to say it is done and dusted before the European stretch of the season is over but this felt monumental. To go from 19th on the grid to victory, against the likes of George Russell and Max Verstappen at the front of the pack, is going to go down in history as the first moment Antonelli demonstrated his F1 world champion credentials.

A gap of 66 points with 10-ish rounds to go isn’t impossible to overturn – just two DNFs and the pressure is right on top of the 20-year-old – but he just doesn’t seem phased by any of it and, if anything, is driving better now than at any point in his burgeoning career in F1.
Antonelli has shown already he can bank solid results when needed, and also charge for the win when it is there for the taking; he effectively did both one after the other at Monza this weekend.

Yes, finishing second to Russell in every race still isn’t enough to mathematically seal the title, but with his team-mate expected to serve a back of the grid penalty for an engine change in Azerbaijan, he has a great opportunity to make that scenario a reality.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes
It’s not over – but Russell will need luck
Antonelli definitely dealt a sizeable blow to Russell’s title hopes in Monza but, as of today, there are 10 rounds to go – 258 points to score.
Russell’s deficit is up to 66 points, and the dynamic isn’t favourable to him, as frustration will understandably be growing – though he was very gracious in defeat on Sunday.

In order to make up such a substantial gap, Russell will need the stars to align. Antonelli doesn’t have many off days; in 13 grands prix so far this season, he has finished on the podium 11 times to Russell’s seven.

That remarkable consistency typically leads to a world title, with few examples to the contrary. Coincidentally, it happened just last year. Oscar Piastri also had 11 podiums from the first 13 rounds, by which time he was 16 points ahead of team-mate Lando Norris and 81 points clear of Max Verstappen, but he ended up outscored by both.

Other than that, the most recent one was Nico Rosberg in 2014. The German had recorded 11 podiums in the first 13 races, but team-mate Lewis Hamilton had 10 podium finishes himself and was just 22 points down in the standings. Three times fewer than the current gap, in other words.

So, such a recovery wouldn’t be unprecedented, as shown by Verstappen – but it wasn’t comparable given Russell and Antonelli have the same car, unlike the Red Bull racer and the McLaren drivers last year. So, while there’s hope, the Briton really is a long shot by now.

There’s really very little to suggest anything can still stop Antonelli from clinching the title this year after his Monza victory. If anyone had doubts before, this weekend probably removed the last arguments for predicting any other outcome - barring something going completely wrong for the Italian off track.

After all, Isack Hadjar didn’t exactly plan to miss a couple of races. So, as long as Antonelli stays away from boxing gloves for the next couple of months, he should be fine. If he shows up on the grid - regardless of where he starts, apparently - he looks set to become world champion at the age of 20.

It’s not only about Antonelli, either. Russell, still his closest rival, doesn’t just need to close a massive points gap - he has to do something even more difficult: maintain the belief that he can still beat Antonelli on any given weekend.
Given how this season has unfolded, and the speed of the Italian’s progress, it must be daunting for the Briton to see just how brilliant his young team-mate has become.

Monza also confirmed Ferrari is probably out of the picture. Charles Leclerc never really was in it, and now he’s simply too far behind to seriously think about the title. And Hamilton doesn’t appear to have a car capable of challenging the Mercedes drivers consistently. The same applies to Norris and McLaren, whose weaknesses were exposed again this weekend.

I just don't see a way back for Russell. I really don't. Yes, there are a lot of points on the table, stranger things have happened in F1, and those formidable Mercedes power units have been glass cannons. I get all that.
But the manner in which Antonelli has been amassing race wins, and collecting whichever result is available when Mercedes doesn't enjoy its usual supremacy, is a quite a marvel for a 20-year-old.

Russell is turning things around, but even that doesn't appear to be enough to be beating Antonelli on a regular basis and that's exactly what he would have to do. Not keeping pace, as he is roughly doing now, but battering Antonelli.
I just don't see it happening, because I'm afraid Russell has met his match in the young Italian.

What's more, the Italian Grand Prix was supposed to be Antonelli's mulligan, his joker race where taking his fifth power unit meant an exercise in damage limitation. Instead of sustaining damage, he has dealt Russell a mental hammer blow. Meanwhile, Russell still has to take his engine penalty later on, and there isn't a circuit left where overtaking will be this easy.

The conclusion to last year's title race has shown that 10 races is an eternity, but that was when the best driver of his generation was doing the chasing. Now, the best driver of the next generation is out in front, and he looks bulletproof. I am going to call it here.

尼科·罗斯伯格驳斥了有关梅赛德斯在蒙扎偏袒基米·安东内利（安东内利）而非乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）的说法
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利（安东内利），梅赛德斯；乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔），梅赛德斯
2016年F1世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格坚决否认了有关梅赛德斯在意大利大奖赛上偏袒基米·安东内利而非乔治·拉塞尔的说法，并坚称这支位于布拉克利的车队在其车手之间保持着严格的平等。
蒙扎的比赛结果令人瞩目，Antonelli 从第 19 位发车，借助比赛中段的一场虚拟安全车进站换上全新的中性胎，在主场拿下了一场精彩的胜利。领跑比赛的 Russell 则留在赛道上继续使用硬胎，最终把胜利拱手让给了队友。
赛后，主持人 Simon Lazenby 在 天空体育 F1 节目中谈到这一情况时质疑：由于这位意大利车手在车手积分榜上领先，梅赛德斯 是否偏向了 Antonelli。
“不，不，不，不，不，”Rosberg 说，“两人机会均等。必须如此。事实也正是如此。他们都在为总冠军而战。”
曾在 2010 年至 2016 年间效力 梅赛德斯 的 Rosberg 解释说，梅赛德斯 的内部规程会自动给予领跑的那辆赛车在策略上的优先权。
"车队内部非常清楚。乔治是领跑比赛的人。他得到的是以最快方式完成比赛的最好策略,"这位前车手补充道。
"他获得第一选择。不管基米在哪里、在做什么或无论什么,他都能得到。这正是梅赛德斯现在需要确认的。在那一刻,对乔治来说,最好的方式是留在外面不进站换那套中性胎。如果是这样,那一切就简单且公平了。"
当被问及梅赛德斯是否因为拉塞尔在领跑而可能不想让他进站时,罗斯伯格继续说:"这很难说。正如我所说,乔治必须得到最好的策略,因为他在领跑。所以无论策略是什么,他都必须得到最好的策略。"
"而事实必然是,继续用那套硬胎留在外面是到达终点的最快方式,因为他只剩一套用过的中性胎了。从外面很难知道,但我希望情况确实如此。"
安东内利（Antonelli）目前在车手积分榜上已将对队友拉塞尔（Russell）的领先优势扩大到66分，后者排名第二。
detailEn: Nico Rosberg rejects Mercedes favouritism claims after F1 Italian GP
Nico Rosberg has dismissed suggestions Mercedes favoured Kimi Antonelli over George Russell at Monza
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes

2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg has firmly rejected suggestions that Mercedes favoured Kimi Antonelli over George Russell during the Italian Grand Prix, insisting the Brackley outfit maintains strict equality between its title contenders.

The race at Monza resulted in Antonelli securing an impressive win on home soil from 19th on the grid, capitalising on a mid-race virtual safety car to pit for fresh medium tyres. Race leader Russell remained on track on hard tyres and ultimately lost the win to his team-mate.
Addressing the situation on Sky Sports F1 after the race, presenter Simon Lazenby questioned whether Mercedes acted in Antonelli's favour because the Italian leads the drivers' championship.
"No, no, no, no, no," Rosberg said. "Equal opportunity for both. It has to be the case. And that is the case. They're racing for the championship."
Rosberg, who drove for Mercedes from 2010 to 2016, explained that Mercedes' internal protocols automatically grant the leading car priority on strategy.
"It's very clear internally in the team. George is leading the race. He gets the best strategy to get, in the fastest way possible, to the end of the race," the former driver added.

"He gets the first choice. Doesn't matter where Kimi is or what he is doing or whatever, he gets it. And that's what Mercedes now needs to confirm. At that point, for George, the best way was to stay out and not come in and take those medium tyres. And if that's the case, then it's all easy and fair."

When asked if Mercedes might not have wanted to pit Russell as he was leading, Rosberg continued: "It's a hard one. As I say, George has to get the best strategy because he's leading. So he has to be given the best strategy, whatever it is.

"And it has to have been that it's the fastest way to get to the end by staying out on those hards because he only had a used medium set left. It's hard to know from outside, but I hope that that was the case."
Antonelli has now extended his lead in the drivers' championship to 66 points over his team-mate Russell, who sits second.

detailZh: 小红牛车手角田裕毅因重启程序违规被传唤，面临失去F1积分的风险
在F1意大利大奖赛上，角田裕毅因起步程序失误被FIA比赛干事传唤
角田裕毅正面对FIA比赛干事的调查，他们正在审查这位日本车手在F1意大利大奖赛上的重启表现。
在第2圈勒克莱尔事故触发红旗后，第6圈重启时，Tsunoda在进入发车区第14位时，似乎把车停出了他的发车格。
赛会控制迅速报告了一个潜在问题，但干事们选择在赛后重新审议此案，角田裕毅和他的小红牛车队被传唤到干事办公室，理由是“涉嫌违反FIA F1规则第B5.9.4条——15:41的发车程序违规”。
角田裕毅在蒙扎这条高速赛道度过了一个强劲的下午，在他出战的第二场大奖赛中拿到了本赛季的第一个积分，以第十名完赛，而他的小红牛队友Arvid Lindblad在F1中游集团经过漫长的尾流缠斗后获得第八名。
在上赛季末失去正式席位后，角田裕毅成为红牛的储备车手，并回到老东家小红牛车队，顶替劳森——后者在红牛车队替代受伤的哈贾尔。
“从14号和15号之间发车让我有点困惑，”角田解释说。“在我看来，红旗之前我并没有真正提升位置。我以为自己是第15位。
“但至少我停在箱子后面，挺远的，所以我不认为我因此获得任何优势。所以走着瞧吧。我希望一切都好。”
detailEn: Racing Bulls driver Yuki Tsunoda summoned for restart infringement, risks losing F1 point
Tsunoda has been summoned by the FIA race stewards for a start procedure error at Formula 1's Italian Grand Prix
Yuki Tsunoda is facing the FIA race stewards as they investigate the Japanese driver's restart at the Formula 1 Italian Grand Prix.
On the lap 6 restart, which followed a red flag for Charles Leclerc's accident on lap 2, Tsunoda appeared to park out of his grid box as he took up his 14th position on the starting grid.

Race control swiftly reported a potential issue, but the stewards opted to revisit the case after the race, with Tsunoda and his Racing Bulls team summoned to the stewards' office for an "alleged breach of Article B5.9.4 of the FIA F1 Regulations – Start Procedure infringement at 15:41."

Tsunoda enjoyed a strong afternoon at Monza's high-speed venue as he collected his first point of the campaign in his second grand prix outing, finishing tenth as his Racing Bulls team-mate Arvid Lindblad grabbed eighth following a long slipstreaming battle in F1's midfield.

Having lost his regular seat at the end of last season, Tsunoda became Red Bull's reserve driver and returned to his former team Racing Bulls deputising for Liam Lawson, who replaced the injured Isack Hadjar at Red Bull Racing.
"I was a bit confused starting between 14 and 15," Tsunoda explained. "In my view, I didn't really gain the position before the red flag. I thought I was 15th.
"But at least I parked behind the box, pretty far, so I don't think I gained any advantage for that. So let's see. I hope everything is okay."

detailZh: Martin Brundle：乔治·拉塞尔必须就意大利大奖赛虚拟安全车（VSC）的决策向梅赛德斯提出质疑
马丁·布伦德尔表示，梅赛德斯在意大利大奖赛的策略可能让乔治·拉塞尔错失胜利，他必须就此向车队讨要说法
前F1车手、天空体育解说员马丁·布伦德尔坚称，由于虚拟安全车期间的策略可能让乔治·拉塞尔在意大利大奖赛上与胜利失之交臂，他必须从梅赛德斯那里得到解释。
在蒙扎，拉塞尔本有望缩小与总冠军竞争对手兼队友基米·安东内利之间的差距。当虚拟安全车出动期间，拉塞尔选择留在赛道上继续使用硬胎，而安东内利则被召进站换上全新的中性胎。这位20岁的车手利用轮胎优势在场上不断超越，最终在自己的主场大奖赛中夺冠。
"对乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）来说，这是非常艰难的一天，"布伦德尔解释道。"他肯定得坐下来和车队谈谈，问问：'怎么会变成这样？我当时正领跑比赛，为什么当时没有给我优先的便宜进站？'"
安东内利在意大利大奖赛接受了动力单元处罚，被排到发车区末位，这给了拉塞尔一个缩小积分榜差距的绝佳机会。
"对于世界冠军争夺战来说，这本是乔治弥补差距的机会，结果差距反而扩大了，"布伦德尔补充道。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利（安东内利），梅赛德斯；乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔），梅赛德斯。
前W系列赛车手、天空体育评论员Naomi Schiff附和了Brundle的看法。"我认为，我们看到他现在对此如此冷静，也许是因为他可能也在质疑自己，以及为什么他没能取得更大的优势。"
"但我认为，事后回想起来，他会问一些问题，比如，'为什么我没有在虚拟安全车期间进站？'
"是的，他采用的是不同的策略，车队想让他跑长距离，但归根结底，一套更新鲜的轮胎本可以为他保住今天的胜利。"
Antonelli在蒙扎夺得了他的第七个F1分站冠军，目前在积分榜上以66分的优势领先排名第二的Russell。
detailEn: Martin Brundle: George Russell must question Mercedes over Italian GP VSC call
Martin Brundle says George Russell must question Mercedes after its Italian Grand Prix strategy potentially cost him victory

Former Formula 1 driver and Sky Sports analyst Martin Brundle insists George Russell must get answers from Mercedes after a virtual safety car strategy potentially cost him victory at the Italian Grand Prix.

Russell looked set to reduce the gap to his championship rival and team-mate Kimi Antonelli at Monza. While Russell stayed out on hard tyres during a virtual safety car period, Antonelli was brought in for fresh mediums. The 20-year-old used the tyre advantage to make his way back up the grid and claim the win at his home race.

"It’s been a very difficult day for George Russell," Brundle explained. "He will have to surely sit down and talk to the team, and ask, 'How did that happen? I was leading the race. Why was I not given the preferential cheap pit stop there?'"
Antonelli took a power unit penalty at the Italian Grand Prix, putting him at the back of the starting grid and giving Russell a huge opportunity to close the gap in the standings.
"For the world championship, this was George's opportunity to do something about the deficit, and the deficit has grown," Brundle added.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes

Former W Series driver and Sky Sports pundit Naomi Schiff echoed Brundle's comments. "I think maybe the reason we’ve seen him be so calm about it right now is because he’s probably questioning himself a little bit as well, and why he wasn’t able to get more of an advantage.
"But I think with hindsight, he will be asking questions, like, 'Why did I not get to pit during the VSC?'
"Yes, he was on a different strategy and they wanted him to go long, but at the end of the day, a fresher set of tyres could have saved him the victory today."
Antonelli, who claimed his seventh F1 win at Monza, now leads the standings with a 66-point advantage over Russell in second.
